numerical_claims.claim: Revenue grew by 2.4% to EUR 188.0 million, and EBITDA increased to EUR 27.6 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s unaudited revenue for the period increased by 2.4% and amounted to EUR 188.0 million... Unaudited EBITDA was EUR 27.6 million...

numerical_claims.claim: Most notably, the Group returned to net profitability with EUR 12.2 million, reversing a net loss of EUR 5.2 million in the same period of 2024.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 12.2 million EUR profit; 5.2 million EUR loss (2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 12.2 million EUR profit; 5.2 million EUR loss (2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Unaudited net profit was EUR 12.2 million (net loss of EUR 5.2 million in October-December 2024).

numerical_claims.claim: The Group maintained a disciplined financial position, with net debt remaining stable at EUR 432.4 million and the net debt to EBITDA ratio improving slightly to 3.3.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: As at 31 December 2025, the Group’s net debt amounted to EUR 432.4 million... The net debt to EBITDA ratio stood at 3.3 as at 31 December 2025...

numerical_claims.claim: The company paid a total dividend of EUR 44.6 million (EUR 0.06 per share) in 2025 and proposed a similar dividend for 2026.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: The Annual General Meeting... adopted a resolution to pay a dividend of EUR 0.06 per share in 2025 in the total amount of EUR 44.6 million... the Management Board... intends to propose to the Annual General Meeting the payment of a dividend of 6 euro cents per share.
